title: Builder vote: upvote after a win
shows: A clean task is won; the Builder upvotes two rules that were shown (rule_12 and rule_9) and updates rule_1. The Beta alpha of each rule shown is incremented by the outcome step regardless of the vote.
why_interesting: Shows the two reliability channels: the automatic Beta update (credit to all rules shown) and the Builder's explicit votes.

practice_game.goal: clean some cloth and put it in countertop.

rules_shown_in_first_attempt.rule: When an object must be cleaned and placed: search cabinets first, take the object, go to the sink, clean it with the sink, go to the target, move it there.
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.example: go to cabinet 6, take butterknife 1 from countertop 1, go to sinkbasin 1, clean butterknife 1 with sinkbasin 1, go to countertop 1, move butterknife 1 to countertop 1
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.validation: This game confirms searching cabinets first and moving the object to the target after cleaning.

You open the cabinet 1. The cabinet 1 is open. In it, you see a cloth 3.
You pick up the cloth 3 from the cabinet 1.
You arrive at sinkbasin 1. On the sinkbasin 1, you see nothing.
You clean the cloth 3 using the sinkbasin 1.
You arrive at countertop 1. On the countertop 1, you see a candle 3, a candle 2, a candle 1, and a toiletpaper 1.
You move the cloth 3 to the countertop 1.
